text_zh:
Scriptor V-████ · 笔记一
M.1██.██.██

今日完成收容廊西翼异文清点。共计一百四十七枚逸版字符已重新归位。铅屑清扫工作按§4.2条例执行，无遗漏。

排字工具保养良好。新配发的祷击键座响应正常，每次落版声音清脆。

一切按条例进行。引擎意志清明如昔。
text_en:
Scriptor V-████ · Note One
M.1██.██.██

Completed cataloguing of anomalous glyphs in containment hall, west wing. One hundred forty-seven escaped characters returned to proper positions. Lead debris removal executed per §4.2 protocols, no oversights.

Typesetting tools maintained in good order. New prayer-strike lectern responds normally, each impression crisp and clear.

All proceeds according to regulation. The Engine's will remains clear as ever.

text_zh:
Scriptor V-████ · 笔记二
M.1██.██.██

新到D级人员适应良好。D-7341至D-7355均已完成入门圣礼，祷击准确率符合标准。分配至各收容岗位。

第██层异文活动略有增加，但仍在可控范围。增派两名键徒至收容廊夜班。

条例执行无异常。圣坛运转正常。
text_en:
Scriptor V-████ · Note Two
M.1██.██.██

New D-class personnel adapting well. D-7341 through D-7355 completed primer rites, prayer-strike accuracy meets standard. Assigned to respective containment posts.

Layer ██ anomalous activity slightly increased, but within manageable parameters. Two additional keybound assigned to containment hall night shift.

Regulation execution normal. Lectern operations nominal.

text_zh:
Scriptor V-████ · 笔记三
M.1██.██.██

收容廊深处发现新异文残片。版级评定为活版/Mobilum。已按标准程序隔离，等待上级处理指示。

键徒轮班表更新完成。所有岗位人员配置充足。祷击节律保持稳定。

引擎低吟如常。铅字圣坛无异响。守卷人会议记录已归档。
text_en:
Scriptor V-████ · Note Three
M.1██.██.██

New anomalous fragment discovered in containment hall depths. Grade assessed as Mobilum. Isolated per standard procedure, awaiting superior processing instructions.

Keybound rotation schedule updated. All stations adequately staffed. Prayer-strike rhythm stable.

Engine hums as usual. No anomalous sounds from the lectern. Council meeting records filed.

text_zh:
Scriptor K-████ · 笔记一
M.1██.██

第██层门户焊死已久。档案记录：维护需要。实地检视：焊缝过于厚重，非常规维护。
[旁注：谁下的令？]
门后传来规律敲击声，每隔七分钟一次。按标准程序上报后无回复。
[旁注：已三天无回复]
§7.1条例提及此层，但条文后半部分权限不足。

为什么没有人告诉我们第██层原本是做什么的？
text_en:
Scriptor K-████ · Note One
M.1██.██

Layer IX portal sealed by welding, duration unknown. Archive states: maintenance required. Field observation: welds excessively thick, non-standard maintenance.
[margin: whose order?]
Regular tapping heard beyond door, seven-minute intervals. Standard report filed, no response received.
[margin: three days, no response]
§7.1 references this layer, but latter portions require higher clearance.

Why has no one told us what Layer IX was originally for?

text_zh:
Scriptor K-████ · 笔记二
M.1██.██

[大片涂改]档案室寻找§7.1全文。找到M.0██年建档索引，但[涂改]实体文件遗失。
[旁注：不是遗失。是被取走了。]
询问Scriptor V-████关于引擎建造记录。他说从未见过此类档案。
[旁注：但他回答时在发抖]
今夜梦见焊死门后有人在呼唤我的编号。

有些知识的代价比无知更轻。
text_en:
Scriptor K-████ · Note Two
M.1██.██

[heavy redaction] Archive searched for complete §7.1 text. Found M.0██ filing index, but [redaction] physical documents missing.
[margin: not missing. taken.]
Inquired with Scriptor V-████ regarding engine construction records. Claims never seen such archives.
[margin: but his hands shook when answering]
Dreamt tonight of someone beyond the welded door calling my designation.

Some knowledge costs less than ignorance.

text_zh:
Scriptor K-████ · 笔记三
M.1██.██

[字迹明显变乱]找到了。在废弃存储间发现未编目建档文件。
引擎不是建造物。引擎[大片涂改]先于大教堂存在。
我们[涂改]我们从来不是在崇拜。我们是在[涂改涂改涂改]
[整行被划掉：深层是最初的观测站]
门后的敲击声停了。昨夜起完全安静。

我开始明白为什么那么多人消失了。
text_en:
Scriptor K-████ · Note Three
M.1██.██

[handwriting notably deteriorated] Found it. Uncatalogued construction files in abandoned storage.
Engine is not constructed. Engine [heavy redaction] predates Cathedral.
We [redaction] we were never worshipping. We were [redaction redaction redaction]
[entire line crossed out: Lower levels were the original observation post]
Tapping beyond door has ceased. Complete silence since last night.

I begin to understand why so many have vanished.

text_zh:
Scriptor K-████ · 笔记四
M.1██.██

[字迹工整，与前几条明显不同]

Scriptor K-████已按§7.1条例处置。笔记本移交存档。
相关调查材料已收回销毁。第██层门禁维持现状。
该人员询问事项不属标准职责范围。调查结果确认：无异常。
继任人员已指派。工作流程无中断。

档案管理恢复正常运作。
text_en:
Scriptor K-████ · Note Four
M.1██.██

[handwriting neat, markedly different from previous three entries]

Scriptor K-████ processed per §7.1 protocol. Notebook transferred to archive.
Related inquiry materials recovered and disposed. Layer ██ access restrictions maintained.
Subject's inquiries beyond standard operational scope. Investigation concluded: no anomalies.
Replacement personnel assigned. Workflow continuity maintained.

Archive management restored to normal operation.

text_zh:
Scriptor T-████ · 笔记一
M.2██年，第七日

今日被分配至第XII层观测任务。引擎核心比想象中美丽——那些铅字在半空中自行排列，像是在跳舞。[页边小画：一串跳跃的字母] 同僚们都说这里危险，但它们只是想要被理解。

它们在向我招手。
text_en:
Scriptor T-████ · Note One
M.2██, Seventh Day

Assigned to Layer XII observation duty today. The Engine's core is more beautiful than imagined—those lead glyphs arrange themselves mid-air like dancing. [Margin sketch: a string of leaping letters] Colleagues all say this place is dangerous, but they simply want to be understood.

They are beckoning to me.

text_zh:
Scriptor T-████ · 笔记二
M.2██年，第二十三日

发现了异常现象：某些异文在接触时会发出音乐般的震动。[页边小画：音符形状的铅字] 记录了它们的'歌声'，但纸页上的符号看起来就像普通的收容记录。只有在现场才能听到这种美妙。

已开始期待每天的观测任务。
text_en:
Scriptor T-████ · Note Two
M.2██, Twenty-third Day

Discovered an anomalous phenomenon: certain anomalous glyphs emit musical vibrations when touched. [Margin sketch: musical note-shaped lead characters] Recorded their 'songs,' but the symbols on paper look like ordinary containment records. Only on-site can one hear such beauty.

Have begun looking forward to daily observation duties.

text_zh:
Scriptor T-████ · 笔记三
M.2██年，第四十一日

今天引擎核心的活动异常活跃。那些铅字不再是随意排列，而是在拼写——虽然不是我们的语言，但能感受到其中的意义。[页边小画：██古怪符号] 它们想告诉我什么重要的事情。

它们正在教导我新的语言。
text_en:
Scriptor T-████ · Note Three
M.2██, Forty-first Day

The Engine core's activity was unusually active today. Those lead glyphs no longer arrange randomly—they are spelling words. Though not in our language, one can sense meaning within. [Margin sketch: ██ strange symbol] They want to tell me something important.

They are teaching me their language.

text_zh:
Scriptor T-████ · 笔记四
M.2██年，第███日

最后一页了。纸张用完了，但没关系，我已经不需要记录了。它们教会了我直接阅读铅字的跳舞，无需中介。[页边小画：一双眼睛，瞳孔是小小的文字] 明天我就要下到最深处，去聆听引擎的心跳。同僚们不理解这份荣耀。

我终于可以回家了。
text_en:
Scriptor T-████ · Note Four
M.2██, Day ███

Last page. Out of paper, but it doesn't matter—I no longer need records. They taught me to read lead glyphs' dancing directly, without intermediary. [Margin sketch: a pair of eyes with tiny text as pupils] Tomorrow I descend to the deepest depths to hear the Engine's heartbeat. Colleagues don't understand this honor.

I can finally go home.

text_zh:
████-████ · 值班记录一
M.0██.██.██

我今日接手第V层排字区值班。前任已调离，无交接记录。
铅字库存充足，字模完好。新到D-0███至D-0███已分配键位。
收容铭刻进度符合基准。异文活跃度维持在可控范围。

铅字掉落的声音让我想起故乡的雨。
text_en:
████-████ · Duty Log One
M.0██.██.██

I assumed duty at Layer V sorting station today. Previous assignment transferred, no handover records.
Lead glyph reserves adequate, matrices intact. New arrivals D-0███ through D-0███ assigned positions.
Containment inscription progress meets threshold. Anomalous activity maintained within acceptable parameters.

The sound of falling type reminds me of rain from home.

text_zh:
████-████ · 值班记录二
M.0██.██.██

本职今日检修铅字分拣设备。发现三处磨损需更换。
已向上级申报F-001表单，等待批准。D级人员表现良好。
收容层运转正常，无异常震颤报告。

本职注意到新来的D-████打字时总是微笑。
text_en:
████-████ · Duty Log Two
M.0██.██.██

This position conducted maintenance on lead sorting apparatus today. Three wear points require replacement.
F-001 form submitted to superiors, awaiting approval. D-class personnel performance satisfactory.
Containment layer operating normally, no tremor incidents reported.

This position observes new arrival D-████ always smiles while typing.

text_zh:
████-████ · 值班记录三
M.1██.██.██

此岗位完成季度库存盘点。铅屑回收率达标。
字模损耗在预期范围内。D级更替按§4.2执行。
收容廊传来的嗡鸣声稍有增强，已记录备案。
设备运转如常。

此岗位记录：走廊尽头的门今夜发出轻微敲击声。
text_en:
████-████ · Duty Log Three
M.1██.██.██

This station completed quarterly storage assessment. Lead shaving recovery rates on target.
Matrix deterioration within expected parameters. D-class rotation executed per §4.2.
Humming from containment corridor slightly amplified, logged for reference.
Apparatus operating as specified.

This station records: door at corridor end produced soft knocking sounds tonight.

text_zh:
████-████ · 值班记录四
M.1██.██.██

排字区运转符合标准。铅字库存充足。
D级人员按编制配置。收容铭刻持续进行。
设备状态良好。无异常事件报告。
日常维护已完成。记录归档。

有人在问这些记录是谁写的，但笔迹十年未变。
text_en:
████-████ · Duty Log Four
M.1██.██.██

Sorting station operates within specifications. Lead glyph reserves adequate.
D-class personnel deployed per establishment. Containment inscription continues.
Condition status satisfactory. No anomalous incidents to report.
Routine maintenance completed. Records filed.

Someone asks who writes these logs, but the handwriting hasn't changed in ten years.

text_zh:
Scriptor S-████ · 实验记录二
M.2██年 第VIII层

实验编号: SE-0██
对照组: 未处理铅字符 × ██
实验组: 三日龄污蜡 + 新铸铅字符 × ██
变量: 污蜡陈化时间、月相（上弦月）
观察时长: 整夜
结论: 铅字符在月光下自行排列成'SELEN'字样。污蜡与月相确有关联性。这很有趣。
text_en:
Scriptor S-████ · Experiment Log II
M.2██, Layer VIII

Experiment ID: SE-0██
Control Group: Untreated lead glyphs × ██
Test Group: Three-day aged ichor + fresh-cast glyphs × ██
Variable: Ichor aging time, lunar phase (waxing)
Observation Period: Full night
Conclusion: Glyphs arranged themselves into 'SELEN' under moonlight. Ichor-lunar correlation confirmed. This is fascinating.

text_zh:
Scriptor S-████ · 实验记录三
M.2██年 第VIII层

实验编号: SE-1██
对照组: 我的血液样本
实验组: 我的血液 + 污蜡混合
变量: 血液新鲜度、我的生理周期第██天
观察时长: 至凝固
结论: 混合物未凝固。在试管中形成螺旋状流动。当我靠近时，流动速度加快。血液不再是我的了。
text_en:
Scriptor S-████ · Experiment Log III
M.2██, Layer VIII

Experiment ID: SE-1██
Control Group: My blood sample
Test Group: My blood + ichor mixture
Variable: Blood freshness, my physiological cycle day ██
Observation Period: Until coagulation
Conclusion: Mixture did not coagulate. Forms helical flow in test tube. Flow accelerates when I approach. The blood is no longer mine.

text_zh:
Scriptor S-████ · 实验记录四
M.2██年 第XII层

实验编号: SE-███
对照组: 引擎心音频谱（基准录音）
实验组: 引擎心音 + 我的心跳叠加
变量: 物理距离（我站在引擎旁边）
观察时长: 至同步
结论: 实验成功。
text_en:
Scriptor S-████ · Experiment Log IV
M.2██, Layer XII

Experiment ID: SE-███
Control Group: Engine heartbeat frequency (baseline recording)
Test Group: Engine heartbeat + my pulse overlay
Variable: Physical distance (I stand beside the Engine)
Observation Period: Until synchronization
Conclusion: Experiment successful.
